summary: Layer 1B expands the directly exposed public-company universe for the AI/data-center power bottleneck. The strongest reference anchor is GE Vernova because gas-turbine slots, grid equipment, and electrification orders directly validate the node. The underfollowed lane should prioritize electrical equipment and project-execution chokepoints rather than only utilities or data-center REITs: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear/e-houses and data-center electrical distribution, IES Holdings for electrical/data-center infrastructure execution capacity, and Centrus Energy as a nuclear-fuel-cycle bottleneck tied to advanced nuclear power availability. This is research mapping only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
